approach: Identify the constraint imposed by fixing index k: index k cannot participate in any swap operations.
observation: Since index k cannot move, nums[k-1] will remain at index k forever. For the array to be sorted, nums[k-1] must equal k.
bruteForce: Simulate swapping for each candidate k.
optimalSolution: Iterate through the array and count how many indices i satisfy nums[i] == i + 1.
dryRun: nums=[2,1,3,4,5]. Matching indices: nums[2]=3, nums[3]=4, nums[4]=5 (3 matches). Answer = 3.
edgeCases: Reverse sorted array (answer = 1 if n is odd, 0 if n is even)
